key_insight: A combinatorial vapor-deposition workflow maps the Cs/Pb/Br/Cl design space and identifies a Cs/Pb window of 1.05–1.20, where wide-bandgap perovskites show higher photoluminescence yields.
engineering_relevance: The study provides a scalable, data-driven route to rapidly optimize wide-bandgap perovskite compositions for optoelectronic device applications.
method: Sequential physical vapor deposition to independently tune cation and anion composition
Automated structural, compositional, and optical characterization
High-throughput screening across the quaternary Cs-Pb-Br-Cl space with open dataset release
evidence_signal: More than 500 sample regions were screened, and the analysis linked a high-energy optical transition to elevated PL yield.
watch_item: The reported compositional window and optical correlations are derived from a specific high-throughput platform, so transferability to other fabrication routes or device stacks may require re-validation.
paper_title: Tuning the optoelectronic properties of wide bandgap perovskites: Data-driven insights from combinatorial synthesis and high-throughput experimentation
